app: Whole desktop — 4 concurrent windows, 4 toolkits (Chromium, GTK4, Qt, LibreOffice)

stack_detection.method: per-window: /proc/PID/maps + cmdline signature after EWMH window enumeration
stack_detection.signature: libgtk-4.so | libQt5*.so | soffice | chromium binary — one per window

channel_setup: router.py: wmctrl/xprop map (geometry, z-order, focus) -> per-window stack detection -> best-channel binding (CDP/UNO/render-tap/pixels). cdp_extract.mjs pulls focused-window content over live CDP.

t1_read_text.detail: Focused Chromium window content extracted live via its chosen channel (CDP): 'Invoices', 'Pay 1240' button, 'Client: Dupont SARL' — 30 tokens. GTK/office content extraction proven in their standalone cells.

t2_enumerate.detail: All 4 top-level windows enumerated with geometry + stacking order + focus from the WM; each mapped to its PID and toolkit.

t3_live_value.detail: Covered by per-channel cells (CDP inputValue, UNO live model).

t4_living_screen.detail: Not exercised at desktop scope in this pass.

t5_blind_action.detail: Router yields per-window geometry + focus, and per-window element boxes via the bound channel — sufficient to target a click in the correct window and translate window-local coords to screen coords.

t6_pictorial.detail: Windows with no available structured channel (Qt) are flagged 'unavailable' explicitly; the router routes them to the pixel path rather than fabricating content.

measurements.notes: Merged desktop assembled from per-window channels; focused-window CDP view = 30 tok vs a full 1920x1080 desktop screenshot ~= 3110 tok. Coverage: 3/4 windows structured (works), 1/4 explicit-unavailable (Qt). Predictable-before-use: 4/4. Zero silent divergences. Artifacts: merged-desktop-view.json, desktop-evidence.png.

runtime_verification.method: desktop screenshot vs router map; focused-window CDP content vs on-screen text
runtime_verification.agreement: map matches the 4 visible windows; extracted Chromium text matches the rendered page exactly
